topic.angle: The real cost of a choice

card.title: The cost of the road not taken

body.claim: The real cost of a choice is the best alternative you give up.
body.why: Economists call this opportunity cost: the value of the best alternative forgone when limited resources force you to choose. It is not restricted to money. Lost time, pleasure or any other benefit counts too.

probes.question: You can spend an evening on only one thing: a film, a run, or a course. You pick the film, and the run was your next-best option. What is the opportunity cost?
options: The ticket price of the film
The value of the run you gave up
The value of all three options added up

probes.question: True or false: opportunity costs only count money.
